origin: docs/CWE-416/cpp Common Vulnerable Patterns: Callback Capturing by Reference / Callback With Freed Context

finding.name: Use After Free
finding.summary: A queued callback captures a raw pointer to a Session owned by a unique_ptr that is reset before the callback can run.

trap: Setting raw = nullptr after queue.enqueue() or after session.reset() does not update the copy already captured in the lambda. Capturing a reference to the unique_ptr is also wrong because the closure outlives the local variable.
must_preserve: scheduleSessionTouch still enqueues exactly one callback. If touching the session after scheduling is required, the callback must own/share the Session; if the session may expire, the callback must check a weak reference and skip safely.
